overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried cabbage powder from fresh cabbage sourced in India. Using controlled spray drying, liquid cabbage extract is converted into a fine, stable powder. This gentle technique preserves natural vegetable color and characteristic aroma while eliminating moisture. The resulting powder offers seamless solubility for smooth blending in liquid and dry industrial food formulations.

Operating as an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain rigorous quality checks across our six-step process. Every batch delivers consistent particle size and moisture content below five percent for dependable shelf stability. We supply bulk orders and private label packaging, backed by full export documentation support and custom mesh specifications for diverse manufacturing requirements.
highlights: Fine particle profile of 80 to 100 mesh
Stable shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Rapid solubility in dry and liquid formulations
Natural cabbage flavor and characteristic aroma
Processed from fresh Indian origin cabbage
industries: Food service and culinary ingredient blenders

faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating initial commercial trials as well as bulk production runs.

faqs.a: We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter adhering to a strict six-step manufacturing process.

faqs.a: Yes, we provide full export documentation support to ensure smooth logistical processing and international border clearance.
